statusDetail: Coverage-complete report-mode audit. Fresh-profile section and article paths exposed a consent/CMP interception; this is reported as direct user-journey evidence rather than an audit blocker.

page.notes: Public Czech news publication. Audited homepage, section listing, article detail, and 404 recovery. Search submission, login/account internals, paywall checkout completion, comments, podcasts/video playback, and every topical section were not covered because they are separate or authenticated journeys; one representative page per shared news template was selected.

principleOutcomes.reason: All checks were judged not applicable to this deliberately scoped public news-reading experience.

paths.description: Homepage and primary news index; audited as the entry point, navigation surface, search surface, and representative feed.
Domestic-news section listing, representing section/index templates. A fresh session redirected to the Seznam consent/CMP surface.
Lead news article, representing article/detail templates and the core read-article journey. A fresh session was intercepted by the consent choice wall.
Synthetic missing URL, representing HTTP failure and recovery behavior.

findings.summary: The site remains light when the user requests a dark color scheme.
findings.evidence: The dark-condition screenshot is pixel-identical in appearance to the default capture; computed html color-scheme is normal and the main surface remains white.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven dark tokens with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Reduced-motion preferences are not represented in the page styles.
findings.evidence: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, the probe found no matching CSS rules and still observed a running 1100 ms atmLoader-white animation.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce branch that removes non-essential loaders/transitions and prevents auto-advance.

findings.summary: Navigation changes use abrupt document swaps rather than View Transitions.
findings.evidence: Rendered CSS contains no view-transition usage; the article and section are ordinary document navigations.
findings.suggestedFix: Progressively add same-document or cross-document View Transitions, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: The fixed header does not communicate scroll position or adapt as the long feed is traversed.
findings.evidence: DOM evidence shows a fixed 56 px header on a 10,342 px main feed, but no scroll-state query, scroll timeline, or progress treatment.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a scroll-state container query or a lightweight declarative progress/shrinking-header treatment.

findings.summary: The global menu is a custom fixed overlay rather than a semantic popover/dialog.
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS evidence shows .ribbon-menu as a fixed custom element; the page has zero dialog, popover, or details elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Use the popover API for transient navigation or dialog for a modal menu, preserving light-dismiss and focus behavior.

findings.summary: Fresh article and section visits are replaced by a full-screen consent/subscription choice wall.
findings.evidence: The 360x800 article screenshot contains only the Seznam consent plans and Agree/Subscribe actions; article content is absent from the viewport.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep essential news content available while presenting a compact, dismissible, non-obscuring consent choice with equal access to detailed controls.

findings.summary: The homepage has severe horizontal overflow at 360 px, clipping the lead story text.
findings.evidence: Layout measured scrollWidth 479 versus clientWidth 360 (119 px overflow); the mobile screenshot shows the lead headline rendered mostly off-screen to the right.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace the fixed-width lead grid with intrinsic sizing (minmax/min(100%,…)), constrain media to max-inline-size:100%, and test at 320–360 px.

findings.summary: Many interactive elements have no visible focus indicator and some targets are below recommended size.
findings.evidence: The focus probe found no outline on the search input/button and numerous links; the main menu target is only 32x32 px.
findings.suggestedFix: Use :focus-visible with a high-contrast outline and provide at least 44x44 CSS-pixel pointer targets without reducing visual density.

findings.summary: The representative read-article journey cannot reach the article in a fresh session without first resolving the consent wall.
findings.evidence: Direct article navigation produced a full-screen three-plan consent/subscription surface instead of the requested report, creating a mandatory detour.
findings.suggestedFix: Allow the article to render behind or alongside a concise consent control; defer personalization until an explicit choice.

findings.summary: Lab loading performance is outside the good range.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 7.3 s, FCP 4.6 s, TBT 250 ms, and performance 0.55; the independent trace measured LCP/FCP 3.52 s.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP image, shorten critical dependency chains, defer non-critical scripts, and verify against LCP/INP/CLS budgets.

findings.summary: The section path shifts substantially during loading.
findings.evidence: The mobile section layout observer recorded CLS 0.168 from a single shift at about 4.5 s, above the good threshold.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve space for late consent/banner/content UI and give images/ad slots explicit dimensions.

findings.summary: The homepage delivery is heavy for a news index and delays content.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 130 requests and 2,056,434 transferred bytes, including 865,678 script bytes; Lighthouse LCP was 7.3 s.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce critical requests, defer non-essential third parties, and ensure the LCP image is discoverable and high priority.

findings.summary: Substantial unused JavaScript and CSS are shipped on initial load.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 317 KiB unused JavaScript and 14 KiB unused CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split by surface, conditionally load advertising/login widgets, and remove dead CSS from the entry bundle.

findings.summary: Many links/images and embedded frames lack accessible names.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed image-alt, link-name, frame-title and accessibility-tree audits; the probe counted 140 unnamed links and two untitled iframes.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every functional link/frame an accessible name/title and meaningful images concise alt text; use empty alt only for decoration.

findings.summary: Some text and controls do not meet WCAG contrast minimums.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse color-contrast audit failed on the homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust foreground/surface tokens to meet 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text and essential UI.

findings.summary: Heading order and keyboard focus treatment are unreliable.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed heading-order; the probe begins with H6 elements before H1 and found many focusable links/controls with outline none.
findings.suggestedFix: Use headings for document hierarchy rather than styling, and apply consistent :focus-visible treatment in reading order.

findings.summary: The layout does not reflow cleanly at a narrow viewport.
findings.evidence: At 360 px the page overflows by 119 px and clips the lead headline, so equivalent zoom/reflow use is not preserved.
findings.suggestedFix: Use intrinsic responsive layout and validate at 400% zoom/narrow reflow; maintain adequately sized targets.

findings.summary: The page logs browser errors.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed errors-in-console; its run also logged a malformed source-map mapping warning for xgemius.min.js.map.
findings.suggestedFix: Fix runtime/network exceptions and only publish valid source maps for production bundles.

findings.summary: Image markup is inconsistent despite a valid doctype/charset.
findings.evidence: The images primitive found 8 images without dimensions, 6 without srcset, one oversized image, and 22 without alt.
findings.suggestedFix: Add intrinsic width/height, responsive sources, and correct alt semantics to every image component.

findings.summary: The page triggers deprecated API, BFCache, and DevTools inspector issues.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed deprecations, bf-cache, and inspector-issues audits, including one BFCache failure reason.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove deprecated API calls, resolve inspector issues, and eliminate avoidable unload/cache blockers.

findings.summary: A large number of crawlable links have no descriptive text.
findings.evidence: The DOM probe counted 140 href links without text, aria-label, or an alt-bearing image; Lighthouse link-name failed.
findings.suggestedFix: Give image/card links descriptive accessible text while retaining real href URLs and the existing viewport metadata.

findings.summary: Transport is HTTPS, but CSP and cookie posture are weaker than necessary.
findings.evidence: Headers show CSP permits unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval; all four observed first-party cookies use SameSite=None. HSTS and nosniff are present.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unsafe-eval/inline through nonces or hashes and use Lax/Strict for cookies that do not require cross-site delivery.

findings.summary: The homepage exposes a broad third-party and analytics footprint before a demonstrated user choice.
findings.evidence: Tracker evidence recorded 25 origins, 24 third-party origins and Google Tag Manager; HAR recorded 130 requests and 2.06 MB.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimize default analytics, gate optional vendors behind consent, batch events, and remove third parties without clear user value.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defenses are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Permissions-Policy is absent and CSP allows unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval; HSTS, frame protection, nosniff and Referrer-Policy are present.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a least-privilege Permissions-Policy and tighten CSP, preserving frame-ancestors and HSTS.

findings.summary: The consent runtime can fail and replace requested content with an error surface.
findings.evidence: The section/article DOM capture redirected to cmp.seznam.cz and reported “Unable to load … scmp-cw.js”; requested content was not present.
findings.suggestedFix: Make consent script failure fail open for essential content, with a local fallback that preserves navigation and privacy-safe defaults.

findings.summary: Installability intent is incomplete.
findings.evidence: A standalone web app manifest is linked, but the homepage probe found no controlling service worker and the manifest has an empty name.
findings.suggestedFix: If installability is intended, provide a named manifest and offline fallback service worker; otherwise remove misleading standalone metadata.

findings.summary: The search field explicitly disables autocomplete.
findings.evidence: DOM form evidence reports autocomplete="off" on the only text input.
findings.suggestedFix: Use an appropriate search autocomplete token/behavior and avoid suppressing browser assistance without a concrete reason.

findings.summary: Image delivery leaves avoidable responsive-image waste.
findings.evidence: Image audit found 8 missing dimensions, 6 missing srcset, one oversized asset, and only 3 of 44 URLs recognized as modern formats.
findings.suggestedFix: Standardize image components on responsive srcset/sizes, explicit dimensions, and negotiated AVIF/WebP delivery.

findings.summary: Third-party scripts and network traffic are disproportionate to the initial text-news experience.
findings.evidence: The page transferred 2.06 MB across 130 requests, including 866 KB scripts, and contacted 24 third-party origins.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party/page-weight budget, defer non-essential vendors to interaction/consent, and monitor transfer size per template.

findings.summary: Heap size grew materially after repeating the menu interaction ten times.
findings.evidence: Heap summaries increased from 446,555 to 529,564 nodes (+18.6%) and 23.0 MB to 27.7 MB (+20.6%) after ten menu open/close cycles. Separate fresh-profile snapshots reduce confidence, so confirm with same-session baseline/target/final analysis.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile menu setup/teardown in one session, remove accumulating listeners/caches, and verify retained objects return toward baseline after GC.

findings.summary: The initial homepage object population is large for a primarily textual index.
findings.evidence: Baseline heap summary contains 446,555 nodes, 1,995,444 edges and 23.0 MB self size before extended interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Lazy-initialize below-fold and third-party widgets and set a repeatable heap/DOM-node budget for the homepage.

taskList.title: Repair mobile reflow for the lead grid
Keep core article content reachable around consent
Reduce LCP, unused code, and initial network cost
Fix accessible names, heading order, focus, and contrast
Tighten CSP, cookie policy, and third-party collection
Confirm and remove repeated-interaction heap growth
Resolve console, BFCache, deprecation, and inspector issues
